Core Idea:

GEO-TERRA transforms NASA Earth observation telemetry into actionable, hyper-local decisions. By profiling site-specific microclimates (like Jazan City) and scanning for matching global climate twins, it guides precise plant selection, tracks water/heat stress, and identifies ecological risks.
summary: GeoTerra is an interactive, multilingual Earth science platform that makes complex NASA Earth data more accessible, engaging, and multisensory. Developed for NASA’s Earth Jukebox challenge, it combines visual Earth exploration, 3D terrain, data sonification, and an AI assistant, so users can experience environmental data through both sight and sound. GeoTerra also includes guided 30-second tours that walk users through the mission, data layers, Earth duets, AI jukebox, and global accessibility features. To broaden access, the platform supports 14 languages and includes high-contrast mode, dyslexia-friendly type, adjustable text size, reduced motion, colorblind-safe maps, and light and dark themes. This matters because Earth science should not depend on one language, ability, or way of perceiving information.
details:
GeoTerra is an innovative, AI-powered Earth science platform designed to make NASA’s scientific data more accessible, interactive, and engaging. Developed for NASA’s Earth Jukebox Challenge, GeoTerra combines Earth visualizations, interactive 3D terrain, data sonification, and artificial intelligence to help users explore our changing planet through both sight and sound.

The platform features an interactive Earth Jukebox that connects environmental information with sound, allowing users to experience scientific data in a unique, multisensory way. Interactive maps, environmental data layers, and an AI assistant help users explore scientific concepts, while five guided walkthroughs make the platform easy to navigate and understand.

Accessibility is one of GeoTerra’s greatest priorities. The platform supports 14 languages and includes high-contrast mode, dyslexia-friendly fonts, adjustable text sizes, reduced motion, four colorblind-safe map palettes, and light and dark themes. These features aim to make Earth science accessible to people of different abilities, languages, and backgrounds.

GeoTerra was developed using Base44, with technologies including JavaScript, React, JSX, CSS, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, and the team lead helped develop the following codes;

  • src
    • api
      • base44client.js
      • AlertBar.jsx
    • app.jsx
    • index.css
    • main.jsx

Throughout development, we prioritized accessibility, scientific accuracy, creativity, educational value, and user-friendly design.

Our goal is to transform how people interact with Earth science by breaking down barriers between complex scientific information and everyday understanding. By combining technology, sound, and inclusive design, GeoTerra aims to make Earth’s changing environment something everyone can explore, understand, and experience.
